title: 第7章 户外烧烤第8章 拜师
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
清晨的阳光还没照进窗户，宁知初就醒了。
她揉了揉眼睛，看了眼窗外：天还没亮呢...不过昨天睡得早，现在也睡不着了。
想起听人说清晨修炼效果最好，她索性爬起来，推开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
盘腿坐在床上，她翻开《引气入体诀》，试着按照上面的方法引导灵气。
咦？好像挺简单的嘛。
宁知初感觉到一股暖流在体内流动，顺着经脉转了一圈后停在丹田处。
就在这时，窗外的太阳正好升起，一缕金色的阳光照在她身上。
这是...紫气？她惊讶地发现阳光中似乎混着一丝紫色的气息，随着灵气一起进入体内。
不过很快她就发现，虽然能引气入体，但速度实在太慢了。
五灵根果然麻烦...宁知初叹了口气，但还是继续修炼起来。
等她再次睁开眼睛时，窗外的阳光已经变成了橘红色。
我修炼了一整天？她正惊讶着，突然听到敲门声。
打开门，一个圆脸少女正站在门口，眼睛瞪得大大的：咦，这里真的有人住啊？你好，我叫慕陶陶，住在你隔壁！
你好，我是宁知初。
宁知初笑着回应。
你今天怎么没去讲经堂啊？幕陶陶歪着头问。
修炼忘了时间...宁知初不好意思地笑笑。
慕陶陶突然抓住她的手腕，你已经引气入体了？这才三天啊！
她瞪大眼睛，等等...你该不会就是那个在宗门牌匾下顿悟三天的新弟子吧？
宁知初眨巴眨巴眼睛点点头：如果没别人的话，应该就是我了。

慕陶陶激动地跳起来：天呐！
现在全外门都在讨论你呢！
她神秘兮兮地压低声音，有人打赌说第一个引气入体的会是登天梯第一名，我猜肯定是顿悟的那个...等等！
她突然反应过来，该不会...
宁知初沉默一瞬后又继续点了点头。
不会吧！
慕陶陶哀嚎道，我在幻境里看到满屋子灵石，抱着不肯撒手呢！
你怎么看破的？
很简单吧，一看就是假的嘛。
宁知初耸耸肩。
幕陶陶哀怨的看着她，宁知初被看的鸡皮疙瘩撒满地。
content_en:
Ning Zhichu woke up before the morning sun shone through the window.
She rubbed her eyes and looked out the window: It's not yet dawn... But she went to bed early yesterday and couldn't fall asleep now.
Remembering that she had heard people say that practicing in the early morning is most effective, she simply got up and opened the window to let in fresh air.
Sitting cross-legged on the bed, she opened the "Introduction of Qi into the Body" and tried to guide the spiritual energy according to the above method.
Huh? It seems pretty simple.
Ning Zhichu felt a warm current flowing through his body. It circled along the meridians and stopped at the Dantian.
At this moment, the sun just rose outside the window, and a ray of golden sunlight shone on her.
Is this... purple energy? She was surprised to find that there seemed to be a hint of purple mixed in the sunlight, which entered her body along with the aura.
But she soon discovered that although she could draw Qi into her body, the speed was too slow.
The Five Spiritual Roots were indeed troublesome... Ning Zhichu sighed, but continued to practice.
When she opened her eyes again, the sunlight outside the window had turned orange.
Did I practice all day? She was surprised when she suddenly heard a knock on the door.
Opening the door, a round-faced girl was standing at the door, her eyes widened: Hey, does anyone really live here? Hello, my name is Mu Taotao and I live next door to you!
Hello, I am Ning Zhichu.
Ning Zhichu responded with a smile.
Why didn't you go to the lecture hall today? Mu Taotao tilted his head and asked.
I lost track of time while practicing... Ning Zhichu smiled sheepishly.
Mu Taotao suddenly grabbed her wrist. Have you already introduced Qi into your body? It’s only been three days!
Her eyes widened, wait... Could you be the new disciple who had three days of enlightenment under the sect's plaque?
Ning Zhichu blinked and nodded: If there is no one else, it should be me.
Mu Taotao jumped up excitedly: Oh my God!
Now everyone outside is discussing you!
She lowered her voice mysteriously. Someone made a bet that the first person to introduce Qi into the body would be the first person on the ladder to heaven. I guess it must be the one who has an epiphany... Wait!
She suddenly realized, could it be...
Ning Zhichu was silent for a moment and then continued to nod.
No way!
Mu Taotao wailed, I saw a room full of spiritual stones in my fantasy world, and I was holding them and refused to let go!
How did you figure it out?
It's very simple. It's fake at first glance.
Ning Zhichu shrugged.
Mu Taotao looked at her sadly, and Ning Zhichu had goosebumps all over the floor.
